name: io.github.butterski/rayomd-mcp
title: RayoMD
description: Markdown to PDF natively: no browser or TeX, the same PDF every run, files kept inside --root.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: A folder the tools may read and write in (repeatable; default the working folder)

environmentVariables.name: RAYOMD_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The rayomd binary to use instead of rayomd on PATH or the pinned release download

environmentVariables.name: RAYOMD_GUI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The RayoMD GUI binary for open_in_gui instead of rayomd-gui on PATH
